summary: Ares Real Estate Income Trust Inc. filed an 8-K solely to disclose an updated net asset value (NAV) per share calculation as of April 30, 2026, and to describe the valuation procedures supervised by its board and independent valuation advisor, Altus Group. This monthly NAV update is a routine disclosure for the company's share classes; no transaction, tender offer, or substantive corporate event occurred. There is no price per share offer, premium, deal terms, or strategic change—merely a periodic net asset value report without any special situation.
